answer: Sybil farms self-fund: one puppet's rewards pay the next one's bond, so clusters compound without new money. Collateral provenance closes that loop. Each seat posts a jade bond into a vault; before it clears, the chain traces where the jade came from. If any traces back to rewards earned by the same operator cluster within twelve epochs, the bond is refused and the seat sits on tundra, frozen ground yielding nothing until clean capital arrives. Every new puppet then needs fresh funds, so the thousandth fake costs as much as the first, while honest seats bond from savings and never notice.
